load.note: Upstream steady_clock around one context creation; files were hashed just before launch, so the page cache is warm for this load.

system_memory.scope: whole harness capture including load; not per-generation or per-stage
system_memory.unit_convention: Printed MB treated as MiB; divide by 1024 for approximate GiB

residency: all weights resident; one load, 14 passes
timing_method: ed-sample steady_clock per-pass stdout (1 ms rounding); stages from the engine "flux generate breakdown" line (10 ms rounding)
precision_note: GGUF Q4_0 transformer, Q4_K_M encoder (see model), BF16 VAE; FP32 activations
flash_attention_evidence: command-line flag only; the engine log does not report it

unavailable_metrics.denoise_step_i_ms: Engine prints completed steps without individual timestamps.
unavailable_metrics.peak_alloc_gib/peak_reserved_gib/device_: No per-generation allocator observations; whole-system tegrastats only.
unavailable_metrics.deterministic_output: Only final repeat image retained; earlier image hashes unavailable.
